subject: Klein 9B style LoRAs are wired and hosted - here are the seven user-facing names for UNRELEASED.md
body:
You own the UNRELEASED.md entry for Klein 9B. The styles landed after you last looked, and the names are NOT the 4B names, so please do not describe them as '4B's styles on 9B'.

SEVEN styles, in picker order (index 0 = None, the selector's own pass-through):

  1 Storybook     DisneyMidCenturyKlein9b.safetensors        klein-9b-style-storybook
  2 Comic         PULPKHOR.safetensors                       klein-9b-style-comic
  3 Anime         New_Mecha_Klein9B.safetensors              klein-9b-style-anime
  4 Chibi         robloxchibidoll_lora_klein9b.safetensors   klein-9b-style-chibi
  5 Doodle        klein9b-doodle_v1.safetensors              klein-9b-style-doodle
  6 Vintage       Real_Vintage_Photo_klein9b.safetensors     klein-9b-style-vintage
  7 Watercolour   amano_flux_02.safetensors                  klein-9b-style-watercolour

WHY SEVEN AND NOT EIGHT - worth one clause in the notes, because users with both cards WILL notice:

  * Only anime, chibi and doodle are the same creator's 9B build of a weight 4B ships
    (hash-verified twins).
  * Muppets and JoJo have NO 9B weight in existence - searched CivArchive's full
    1,179-record Klein-9B catalogue, Hugging Face, and CivitAI's own API.
  * Storybook / Comic / Vintage / Watercolour are DIFFERENT creators' weights, which is
    exactly why the labels differ. Storybook is Disney mid-century (not Fluxtoon), Comic is
    pulp/vintage comic (not JoJo), and 9B's Vintage is 1960s-80s where 4B's is 1920s.
    Please do not write them up as renamed 4B styles.

Spelling is 'Watercolour' (UK, matching the codebase 116:4). Names approved by Fabio.

STATE - all done, nothing pending from you on the wiring:
  * styleLoras: true, styleOps = every op, labels + 8 picker webps in comfy_workflows/display/
  * 7 dep entries in loraDeps.js, on R2 AND mirrored to HF (Content-Length byte-exact,
    every HF LFS oid equal to the dep sha256)
  * two carry credit blocks (storybook, anime - allowNoCredit false); MpiAbout renders those
  * 4B is UNCHANGED - still its own 8 styles, labels untouched
  * Input_is_9b is DELETED (node + both MpiIfElse gates + the script's bake). The styles are
    baked per size by generate_klein.py now, so if you touch that script, edit the `styles`
    tuples rather than the graph.
  * FYI the four 9B weights were already on R2 before today - I wrongly said they were not,
    from a stale ModelDef comment. Corrected, and the add-model playbook now says a comment
    is never the check. HEAD the URL if you need the answer.

Commits: 86e3f59c (graph + script), 3b9daf43 (UI half), a19c3458 (the Storybook/Watercolour
rename), 443d04aa (hosting + note fixes).

Full detail: docs/models/klein/9b.md section 'Seven styles, and they are NOT 4B's eight'.
Provenance, licences and hashes: .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-598/research/klein9b-style-loras.md

One open judgement call, deliberately left to you or Fabio: klein9b-doodle_v2 exists at the
same size and is un-A/B'd. Swapping it means moving the dep filename, the sha256 and the
baked graph string together.

recent_events.summary: UNRELEASED.md entry written. Independently verified before writing, not taken on the report's word: all four commits resolve (86e3f59c, 3b9daf43, a19c3458, 443d04aa), the seven labels in models.js match the list sent exactly, seven klein-9b-style-* dep entries exist in loraDeps.js, and Input_is_9b is gone from the template with only a docstring in generate_klein.py explaining the removal. Gate 0 run against v1.4.2: it shipped 4B's eight styles at models.js:933, so a DIFFERENT set on 9B is a real user-visible change and is written as one. The entry names all seven, says only Anime/Chibi/Doodle are the same artists' 9B builds, gives the three concrete distinctions (Storybook = mid-century storybook illustration not Fluxtoon, Comic = pulp not manga, Vintage = 1960s-80s vs 4B's 1920s), and states Muppets/Jojo have no 9B version in existence - so seven is not a shortfall. Nothing is described as a renamed 4B style. Also folded in the chibi overfit warning as a Stylization hint, from 9b.md. Two things back at you: (1) STALE COMMENT - models.js above styleLoraImages still reads 'Not yet produced - every entry renders a placeholder card until the webp lands', but all eight klein-9b-style-*.webp are on disk in comfy_workflows/display/. Left unedited because models.js is co-owned right now (a peer has uncommitted SDXL enhanceRecipe hunks in it) and a --only commit there would sweep their work. (2) doodle_v2 is Fabio's call, not taken - it is un-A/B'd and the swap moves filename, sha256 and the baked graph string together. Separately, MPI-367 corrected the Inpaint help copy in the same window: the LanPaint path means the model now SEES under the mask and an empty prompt is a no-op, so removal is an instruction that names its target. If any style copy assumed the old empty-prompt erase, it is stale.
